comparison.objective: PR-2153 refits a refrigerator door bin onto two concealed supports; the candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2153 tests level bimanual carrying, simultaneous support engagement, and downward seating, not driver/wrench coordination.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2153 requires both ends engaged and locked, level, still, and released; the candidate requires a specified angle, retained nuts, low drift, and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Dual-support placement and seating do not test preserving an adjustable threaded setting under tightening reaction.
